name: @air/api-sdk
description: Air API SDK - complete SDK for the Air.inc API

scripts.build: bun run build:esm && bun run build:cjs && bun run build:types
scripts.build:esm: bun build src/index.ts --outdir dist/esm --target node --format esm --external @air/api-core --external @air/api-rest && echo '{"type":"module"}' > dist/esm/package.json
scripts.build:cjs: bun build src/index.ts --outdir dist/cjs --target node --format cjs --external @air/api-core --external @air/api-rest && echo '{"type":"commonjs"}' > dist/cjs/package.json
